text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...A placed finish, huh. I couldn't quite 
take that final step.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. ...But that alone 
isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Run as your heart wills and win. Clash 
with pure tenacity and win.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Unless I have it all—it's no good.

Fufu, that's right! This is who I am—Mr. 
C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the wind is blowing in our favor. 
I'm definitely going to win the next race!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh? For real? I'm definitely gonna get 
bored halfway through, though.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I know! If we're going to do a reflection 
meeting, let's make it a fun one.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
This is your chance to show what you're 
made of, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, pulling out every trick in the 
book, I held our review session while 
keeping Mr. C.B. laughing throughout.
